title: micranthemum glomeratum
intro: Micranthemum glomeratum, commonly known as the carpetweed or creeping micranthemum, is a small, flowering plant native to the Americas. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Micranthemum glomeratum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic effects, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
